# Local LLM benchmark

> Local language models benchmarked on one workstation (Apple M5 Max 128GB) on bounded, checkable text work: code, math and finance, logic, extraction, instruction constraints, tool calls. Every item has a deterministic scorer; there is no LLM judge. Each result describes a model on a stack (runtime, quant, chat template, sampler settings) on that machine, with a 95% interval.

Notes:

- Pages are markdown and quote snapshot digests; cite a digest with any number you reuse.
- Pass rates count a missing or failed item as a fail (coverage adjustment). Configs within one tier are not statistically resolved from each other; prefer tiers over single-rank differences.
- The pre-release (draft) set is newest and largest but may still change; the alpha challenge set is archival.
- The same data, interactive, needs JavaScript: https://vcarl.com/evals/

## Alpha challenge set

- [Leaderboard](https://vcarl.com/evals/llms/alpha/leaderboard.md): 110 configs ranked by pass rate with 95% intervals and tiers; links to each config's page
- [Release notes](https://vcarl.com/evals/llms/alpha/release.md): release facts, challenge list, snapshot digests
- [Errata](https://vcarl.com/evals/llms/alpha/errata.md): 7 errata with the scores each changed
- [Challenge code](https://vcarl.com/evals/llms/alpha/challenges/code.md): 12 items, per-config pass rates
- [Challenge constraint](https://vcarl.com/evals/llms/alpha/challenges/constraint.md): 10 items, per-config pass rates
- [Challenge economics](https://vcarl.com/evals/llms/alpha/challenges/economics.md): 35 items, per-config pass rates
- [Challenge effect-ts](https://vcarl.com/evals/llms/alpha/challenges/effect-ts.md): 26 items, per-config pass rates
- [Challenge factual](https://vcarl.com/evals/llms/alpha/challenges/factual.md): 7 items, per-config pass rates
- [Challenge financial](https://vcarl.com/evals/llms/alpha/challenges/financial.md): 26 items, per-config pass rates
- [Challenge logic](https://vcarl.com/evals/llms/alpha/challenges/logic.md): 10 items, per-config pass rates
- [Challenge math](https://vcarl.com/evals/llms/alpha/challenges/math.md): 13 items, per-config pass rates
- [Challenge smoke](https://vcarl.com/evals/llms/alpha/challenges/smoke.md): 4 items, per-config pass rates
